hypothesis: The register-router features often substituted an intermediate/arranged MIDI value for the original detected source key. Recover the actual value with exact sourceIndex joins, requiring unchanged playback plus matching source instrument and pitch class. This is a feature repair, not an improvement to model audio by itself.

frozenRefit.validation: complete-song leave-one-out over five non-WANE songs

acceptance: The unchanged strict cross-song policy selector must pass. Then measure whole-song output against the same reference/clock, including WANE transfer and listening. Do not enable a rejected profile.
interpretation: Training and application receive the same repaired source feature. No reference coordinates are used in inference or feature repair, no forced blanket octave shift is introduced, and no production weights/profile are changed.
